name: Healthcare Price Capping & Margin Retaliation Simulation
simulation_requirement: Simulate how corporate hospital CFOs, independent medical specialists, insurance TPAs, and activist patients will respond if a mandatory Rs. 4,000/day room rent cap and 15% consumable markup ceiling is enforced. Will hospitals retaliate by inflating OT or diagnostic charges?
analysis_summary: Ontology models the multi-stakeholder healthcare financing ecosystem in India. Captures hospital CFO margin defense mechanisms, surgical specialist autonomy, TPA adjudication friction, and patient community grievance mobilization.
